description: Universal Official Data Source Registry — SEA Change Intelligence Dashboard

WB_API.name: World Bank Open Data API
WB_API.limitations: Annual data; 1-2 year publication lag; gaps for fragile states

IMF_DATA_API.name: IMF Data API (IFS, BOP, GFS, WEO)
IMF_DATA_API.limitations: Comprehensive IFS/BOP/GFS datasets; requires dataset navigation

ASEANSTATS.name: ASEANstats
ASEANSTATS.limitations: Annual ASEAN aggregate; HTML interface; proxied via WB API

UN_COMTRADE.name: UN Comtrade Plus
UN_COMTRADE.limitations: Free 500 calls/hr; bilateral trade flows by partner

OECD_STATS.name: OECD Statistics (SDMX API)
OECD_STATS.limitations: OECD members only; comprehensive quarterly data

ILO_ILOSTAT.name: ILO Statistics (ILOSTAT API)
ILO_ILOSTAT.limitations: Labor force participation, employment by sector, wages; country coverage varies

FAO_FAOSTAT.name: FAOSTAT - UN Food and Agriculture
FAO_FAOSTAT.limitations: Crop production, food prices, trade; 1-2 year lag

WHO_GHO.name: WHO Global Health Observatory
WHO_GHO.limitations: Health indicators; life expectancy, mortality, nutrition

ENERGY_IEA.name: International Energy Agency
ENERGY_IEA.limitations: Requires API key; most comprehensive energy dataset

ENERGY_WB.name: World Bank Energy Indicators
ENERGY_WB.limitations: Renewable energy share, electricity access, CO2 emissions

WTO_STATS.name: WTO Statistics (Trade)
WTO_STATS.limitations: Merchandise and services trade; tariff data

BIS_STATS.name: Bank for International Settlements
BIS_STATS.limitations: Credit gaps, banking statistics, FX reserves

UNWTO_STATS.name: UN World Tourism Organization
UNWTO_STATS.limitations: International tourist arrivals and receipts; annual

GDELT_NEWS.name: GDELT Project (Real-time News Signal)
GDELT_NEWS.limitations: News signals only — NOT statistics; use for sentiment/risk only

ACLED_CONFLICT.name: ACLED (Armed Conflict Location & Event Data)
ACLED_CONFLICT.limitations: Requires free API key; conflict events, protests, violence data

TI_CPI.name: Transparency International Corruption Perceptions Index
TI_CPI.limitations: Annual CPI score; perception-based, not statistical

WEF_GCI.name: World Economic Forum Global Competitiveness Index
WEF_GCI.limitations: Survey-based; GCI discontinued 2020; replaced by GCI 4.0

HERITAGE_EF.name: Heritage Foundation Economic Freedom Index
HERITAGE_EF.limitations: Composite index; not official national statistics

NSO_THA_NESDC.name: NESDC Thailand (Quarterly GDP)
NSO_THA_NESDC.limitations: Thai language primary; quarterly GDP with advance estimates

CB_THA_BOT.name: Bank of Thailand
CB_THA_BOT.limitations: Full API requires key; public tables via scraping

MIN_THA_CUSTOMS.name: Thai Customs Department (Trade Stats)
MIN_THA_CUSTOMS.limitations: Monthly trade by partner/product; HTML tables

MIN_THA_MOC_PRICES.name: Thailand Ministry of Commerce (Price Monitoring)
MIN_THA_MOC_PRICES.limitations: Consumer goods prices; rice and commodity prices

MIN_THA_EPPO.name: Energy Policy and Planning Office Thailand
MIN_THA_EPPO.limitations: Oil imports, electricity generation, energy consumption by sector

MIN_THA_BOI.name: Board of Investment Thailand
MIN_THA_BOI.limitations: Approved FDI investment projects; sector breakdown

NSO_VNM_GSO.name: General Statistics Office Vietnam
NSO_VNM_GSO.limitations: Vietnamese language primary; English version may lag

CB_VNM_SBV.name: State Bank of Vietnam
CB_VNM_SBV.limitations: Limited English coverage; exchange rates and monetary aggregates

MIN_VNM_CUSTOMS.name: General Department of Vietnam Customs
MIN_VNM_CUSTOMS.limitations: Monthly trade statistics; Vietnamese language primarily

MIN_VNM_MOIT.name: Ministry of Industry and Trade Vietnam

NSO_MYS_DOSM.name: Department of Statistics Malaysia (OpenDOSM)
NSO_MYS_DOSM.limitations: OpenDOSM API excellent; some datasets require registration

CB_MYS_BNM.name: Bank Negara Malaysia
CB_MYS_BNM.limitations: Open API; exchange rates, OPR, BOP

MIN_MYS_CUSTOMS.name: Royal Malaysian Customs (via DOSM)
MIN_MYS_CUSTOMS.limitations: Via OpenDOSM API; monthly by partner

MIN_MYS_MITI.name: Ministry of Investment, Trade & Industry Malaysia
MIN_MYS_MITI.limitations: FDI approvals; manufacturing investment; trade promotion

CB_SGP_MAS.name: Monetary Authority of Singapore
CB_SGP_MAS.limitations: Open API; SORA, exchange rates, financial sector

MIN_SGP_MTI.name: Singapore Ministry of Trade and Industry
MIN_SGP_MTI.limitations: Advance GDP estimates and economic survey

MIN_SGP_EDB.name: Singapore Economic Development Board
MIN_SGP_EDB.limitations: FDI commitment by sector; manufacturing investment

NSO_IDN_BPS.name: Statistics Indonesia (BPS)
NSO_IDN_BPS.limitations: Full API requires key; public press releases accessible

CB_IDN_BI.name: Bank Indonesia
CB_IDN_BI.limitations: API in development; HTML tables available; BI Rate, FX

MIN_IDN_BKPM.name: BKPM (Investment Coordinating Board)
MIN_IDN_BKPM.limitations: FDI realization; domestic investment by sector

MIN_IDN_ESDM.name: Ministry of Energy & Mineral Resources Indonesia
MIN_IDN_ESDM.limitations: Coal, oil, gas production; electricity generation; RE targets

MIN_IDN_MOT.name: Indonesia Ministry of Trade (Satudata)
MIN_IDN_MOT.limitations: Trade statistics portal; may change structure

NSO_PHL_PSA.name: Philippine Statistics Authority (OpenStat)
NSO_PHL_PSA.limitations: OpenStat PXWeb API available; PSNA quarterly GDP

CB_PHL_BSP.name: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas
CB_PHL_BSP.limitations: HTML/PDF tables; remittances data very good

NSO_KHM_NIS.name: National Institute of Statistics Cambodia
NSO_KHM_NIS.limitations: Annual data; limited online access; some HTML tables

NSO_LAO_LSB.name: Lao Statistics Bureau
NSO_LAO_LSB.limitations: Limited English data; annual lag typically 2 years

CB_LAO_BOL.name: Bank of Lao PDR
CB_LAO_BOL.limitations: Limited online data; debt sustainability concerns

NSO_MMR_CSO.name: Central Statistical Organisation Myanmar
NSO_MMR_CSO.limitations: Post-coup (Feb 2021): website intermittently available; data severely limited after 2021; use WB/IMF estimates

CB_MMR_CBM.name: Central Bank of Myanmar
CB_MMR_CBM.limitations: Post-coup: limited operations; black market rate diverges significantly

NSO_BRN_DEPS.name: DEPS Brunei Darussalam
NSO_BRN_DEPS.limitations: Limited API; some data in PDF; quarterly GDP available

CB_BRN_AMBD.name: Autoriti Monetari Brunei Darussalam
CB_BRN_AMBD.limitations: Quarterly monetary statistics; limited public API

NSO_TLS_GDS.name: General Directorate of Statistics Timor-Leste
NSO_TLS_GDS.limitations: Very limited statistical capacity; data primarily from WB/IMF

CB_TLS_BCTL.name: Banco Central de Timor-Leste
CB_TLS_BCTL.limitations: Very limited; Timor uses USD; petroleum fund management

NSO_CHN_NBS.name: National Bureau of Statistics China
NSO_CHN_NBS.limitations: English interface available; some methodological differences with international standards

CB_CHN_PBOC.name: People's Bank of China
CB_CHN_PBOC.limitations: English statistics portal; monetary aggregates, FX

MIN_CHN_GACC.name: General Administration of Customs China
MIN_CHN_GACC.limitations: Monthly trade by country and commodity; very detailed

NSO_USA_BEA.name: US Bureau of Economic Analysis
NSO_USA_BEA.limitations: Requires free API key; comprehensive national accounts

NSO_USA_BLS.name: US Bureau of Labor Statistics
NSO_USA_BLS.limitations: Requires free API key; CPI, unemployment, wages

CB_USA_FED.name: US Federal Reserve (FRED API)
CB_USA_FED.limitations: Free API key; FRED has 800k+ series

CB_JPN_BOJ.name: Bank of Japan
CB_JPN_BOJ.limitations: Monetary policy rate, monetary aggregates, exchange rates

CB_IND_RBI.name: Reserve Bank of India
CB_IND_RBI.limitations: Repo rate, FX reserves, banking statistics, BOP

CB_KOR_BOK.name: Bank of Korea
CB_KOR_BOK.limitations: Free API key; policy rate, exchange rates, national accounts

NSO_AUS_ABS.name: Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS API)
NSO_AUS_ABS.limitations: Excellent SDMX API; OECD member; comprehensive

CB_AUS_RBA.name: Reserve Bank of Australia
CB_AUS_RBA.limitations: Cash rate, exchange rates, financial aggregates; CSV downloads

ACE_ENERGY.name: ASEAN Centre for Energy
ACE_ENERGY.limitations: ASEAN energy outlook; electricity access; RE share by country

ASEAN_INV.name: ASEAN Investment Report
ASEAN_INV.limitations: Annual FDI flows; intra-ASEAN + external FDI; PDF/Excel
